paths.openai: The web app never talks to the model; the OpenAI key never goes in apps/web.

patterns.message: The web app reaches the API over HTTP only.
Import sop-core through its package entry points (@sop-agent/sop-core, @sop-agent/sop-core/testing), never a file inside it.

paths.openai: Only the model adapter (model/openaiModelClient.ts), the composition root (start.ts) and the live eval and smoke tooling import the OpenAI SDK. Use the ModelClient interface and model/modelErrors.ts.
